titleLine1: Amauta is not just another educational app.
description: We don't create more generic content. We created the tool that was missing so your child learns at their own pace, without depending on wifi.

adaptive.title: Adapts to their pace
adaptive.description: Not everyone learns the same way. Amauta adjusts the exercises to what your child knows and needs to practice, step by step.

offline.title: Works without internet
offline.description: Most apps go blank without wifi. Amauta works anywhere — at home, in the car, on the go.

progress.title: See their real progress
progress.description: No generic grades. You know exactly what they master and what needs reinforcement, in real time.

earlyTitle: Be among the first to use Amauta
earlyDescription: Families joining now don't just use the app — they help build it. Your feedback decides what gets built first, and for as long as this phase lasts, everything is completely free. No commitments, no hidden costs.

voice.title: Your feedback shapes the app
voice.subtitle: You decide what gets built first

offlineBadge: Always available. No matter what happens with the wifi.
offlineTitle: Most educational apps need a connection to work. Amauta doesn't.
offlineText: Once installed on your child's device, it works the same with wifi as without it — at home, in the car, at grandma's village. When the connection returns, everything syncs on its own. Without losing anything, without your child having to do anything.
offlineQuote: Because learning shouldn't depend on wifi.
